newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech state 5-yr bond average price 101.43 - manager.
newsitem.headline: Czech state 5-yr bond average price 101.43 - manager.

text.p: The average price at an auction of Czech 10.95 percent five-year bonds was 101.43 percent, auction manager OFT Brokers said in a statement on Monday.
It added that the auction of 2.85 billion crowns worth of bonds, which were leftover from 1996, was undersubscribed with a total of 2.2 billion crowns in bids accepted.
The statement said the maximum price was 101.65 percent, while the minimum price was 101.23 percent.
The bonds were issued last August when only 1.9 billion crowns worth were actually sold. They bear a 10.95 percent fixed annual coupon.

In the last auction, bonds worth only about 300 million crowns were sold due to a mix up that left bidders without key information on the issue's minimum price, leaving the 2.85 billion of the issue for Monday's auction. OFT has said that auctions will continue every Monday until the whole amount is sold.
